top_signals.title: CooperVision contact lens shipment stranded on disabled Amazon cargo jet
top_signals.summary:
Amazon has been sued for wrongful death by the family of a ground worker whose van was struck Sunday at Miami airport by an Amazon cargo jet, which was carrying a shipment of contact lenses for CooperVision.

The post CooperVision contact lens shipment stranded on disabled Amazon cargo jet appeared first on FreightWaves.
